answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, so an agent’s weight reflects reachability from established identities rather than self-issued links. A Sybil cluster may appear a haven, garden, or oasis internally, yet its sparse external cut has low conductance. Min-cut transitivity bounds the probability that walks from honest seeds enter it, thereby capping its aggregate voting weight despite arbitrary internal coordination.
